method.ashare: Each backtest day uses only prior A-share K-line data and the latest completed US session; historical news is neutral because point-in-time news archives are not available.
method.us: US quality backtest uses prior daily K-lines plus configured quality/growth/valuation/moat inputs, then measures forward close-to-close returns.
method.target: Forward 1/3/5 trading-day close-to-close returns; this approximates a 9:00 research recommendation and is not an executable open-price fill.
